newsitem.title: USA: NHL ICE HOCKEY-RED WINGS SUSPEND PRIMEAU FOR FAILING TO REPORT.
newsitem.headline: NHL ICE HOCKEY-RED WINGS SUSPEND PRIMEAU FOR FAILING TO REPORT.

text.p: The Detroit Red Wings suspended forward Keith Primeau, the subject of numerous trade rumours, for failing to report to training camp Monday
Primeau, centre Steve Yzerman and defenceman Paul Coffey, who represented Team Canada in the World Cup of Hockey, were given until Monday to report to training camp.

Primeau is one of the league's most physical forwards. He had 27 goals and 25 assists and led the Red Wings in penalty minutes with 168 in 74 games last season. But Primeau managed only one goal and four assists in 17 playoff games for the Red Wings, who were eliminated in the Western Conference finals by Colorado.
